name: Crown BRLV
oneLiner: BRLV is Crown's centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, mint/redeemed 1:1 for BRL and backed mostly by Brazilian federal Treasury bonds in segregated custody.
collateral: Brazilian federal government bonds, Tesouro Selic-linked ETFs, and de minimis cash/equivalents held in legally segregated, bankruptcy-remote reserve custody through Crown's guarantor/security-agent structure
pegMechanism: KYC-gated primary-market mint and redemption at 1 BRL per BRLV through Crown; reserves are pledged to BRLV holders through a Brazilian security-agent and fiduciary-assignment structure, while secondary-market price can deviate

mintAuthority.summary: BRLV is issued by Crown on Base and Ethereum through UUPS/AccessControl deployments. The Base and Ethereum tokens share DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA 0x239d4a, whose role can authorize minting and can create token UPGRADE_ROLE holders. Base's live direct minters are two EIP-7702 delegated EOAs plus Crown's canonical gateway and rewards proxies; the latter two have separate immediate UUPS role-admin paths.

controls.label: Crown issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Crown creates BRLV supply against segregated, bankruptcy-remote Brazilian Treasury bond reserves via KYC-gated primary issuance and redeems 1:1 for BRL; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

Verified token implementation source makes _authorizeUpgrade require UPGRADE_ROLE, so this zero-delay EOA can grant that role and authorize a token implementation change as well as manage minters.

review.evidence: At Base blocks 48678900-48679023 and Ethereum block 25540452, both token proxies resolved through zero EIP-1967 admin slots to the listed verified UUPS implementations. The shared DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA 0x239d4a can manage minters and grant UPGRADE_ROLE on both tokens; the Base token also has active UPGRADE_ROLE EOA 0xcdfc72. The Base gateway and rewards minters each resolve to verified UUPS implementations, with their active and role-admin upgrade EOAs recorded. Direct EIP-7702 relay minters are recorded as delegated EOA accounts, not unreviewed proxy administrators. Crown backs BRLV with segregated Brazilian federal Treasury bonds and Tesouro Selic ETFs; Fact Finance performs daily independent reserve verification with full liability reconciliation published on Crown's transparency page (latest report 2026-05-31, ~100.2% backing), so supply is continuously reconciled. Reserve custody sits at BCB-regulated banks, but that is custodial regulation, not issuer supervision: no BCB or CVM registry names Crown/BRLV as a licensed stablecoin issuer, so supervision is attestation-only and BRLV sits in the high tier.
